Recommendation: GCRA (a token bucket expressed as one timestamp per key), 8 bytes per client, 61ns per decision in the benchmark, and it maps onto Envoy's local rate limit filter for the edge tier. Sliding window log is out on memory (one entry per request); sliding window counter is a fine fallback at 24 bytes but has the well-known burst-at-boundary approximation.
